_comment: Course Study App — Single Lecture Slide Deck Index Template (30-50 slides). Keys are bare PDF filenames. CRITICAL: Every physical PDF sheet (including progressive Beamer reveal overlays) MUST have an entry in pageMap without skipping or synthetic padding.

_file_naming_and_placement.rule: Can be saved as a modular per-lecture file (e.g. 'L1_slide_index.json') inside 'Code/src/data/lecture_additions/' alongside the lecture's other addition files, or as a consolidated 'slides_index.json' in 'Code/src/data/'. The app automatically loads and merges all slide indexes into a single unified source.

markdown_and_latex_support.note: ALL STRING FIELDS (title, author, description, pageMap[].title, pageMap[].section) SUPPORT GITHUB-FLAVORED MARKDOWN AND KATEX MATH ($inline$ or $$display$$).
markdown_and_latex_support.mandatory_json_backslash_rule: CRITICAL: In JSON strings, the backslash '\' is an escape character. Every LaTeX command MUST use double backslashes '\\'. Example: '$\alpha$', '$\text{ms}$', '$$\frac{a}{b}$$', '$\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$'. Escape literal dollar signs in prose as \$.
markdown_and_latex_support.code_and_math_rules: Use backticks (`$var`) exclusively for code and variables; use dollar signs ($math$) exclusively for LaTeX math.

_schema_field_definitions.id: String. Unique kebab-case identifier used for internal citations and jumps.
_schema_field_definitions.lecture_index: Integer, String, or Null. Sequence number or index of the lecture in the course (e.g. 1, 2, 3, or 'L1'). Keep 'title' focused on the actual subject topic (e.g. 'Comparing Alternatives and One-Way ANOVA' rather than 'Lecture 3: Comparing Alternatives and One-Way ANOVA'); the app automatically formats and displays the lecture index.
_schema_field_definitions.title: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Full canonical title of the lecture (clean topic title without duplicate 'Lecture X:' prefix if lecture_index is supplied).
_schema_field_definitions.author: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Instructor(s), department, or institution.
_schema_field_definitions.description: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. 1-2 sentence synopsis of core concepts.
_schema_field_definitions.total_slides: Integer. Total physical sheets in the PDF file (len(pdf.pages)).
_schema_field_definitions.total_pages: Integer or Null. Highest printed slide number, or null if unnumbered.
_schema_field_definitions.pageMap: Array of SlideNode objects. Strictly sequential: physical slide 1 to total_slides.
_schema_field_definitions.pageMap[].slide: Integer. Physical sheet number in the PDF (1-indexed).
_schema_field_definitions.pageMap[].page: Integer or Null. Logical/printed slide number on the slide (overlays share the same number).
_schema_field_definitions.pageMap[].title: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Specific, disambiguated slide title capturing the newly revealed content.
_schema_field_definitions.pageMap[].section: MARKDOWN & LATEX STRING FIELD. Module or thematic group name.
